name: cui-bono
description: Asks whose voice a text speaks in and who gains if the reader accepts it. The main skill names the document's shape and register and routes its claims to citation-farm-audit (authors, funders, citation networks, primary data) and its sources to source-provenance (a card of verifiable facts), then deconstructs the findings with the logic skills. With no argument it audits the agent's own previous reply.
